priorityList: Initiate combat by casting Aimed Shot followed by Steady Shot.
Cast Black Arrow on cooldown as your highest priority.
Use Trueshot whenever available, ideally when the target is at low health or you have maximum Bullseye stacks.
Use offensive Trinkets, Racial abilities, and Potions while Trueshot is active.
Cast Rapid Fire if the Unload talent is active and either the target's health is below 20% or you have the No Scope talent.
Spend Precise Shots stacks on Arcane Shot.
Cast Rapid Fire if the Bulletstorm buff duration is shorter than an Aimed Shot cast time.
Cast Aimed Shot as your primary spender and to prevent yourself from capping at 2 charges.
Cast Rapid Fire on cooldown if not already used for higher-priority procs.
Use Steady Shot as a filler when you need to generate Focus or have no other abilities available.
